message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/opensc && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"src/tests/fuzzing/fuzz_pkcs15_reader.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":185,"var":"Data/Size","code":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput(const uint8_t *Data, size_t Size)","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes enter the fuzz harness as the raw input candidate."},
  {"step":2,"file":"src/tests/fuzzing/fuzz_pkcs15_reader.c","function":"fuzz_add_reader","line":159,"var":"reader->drv_data","code":"reader->drv_data = data;","note":"The input buffer is wrapped in a fake reader so later PKCS#15 parsing and card operations consume the same attacker bytes."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src/tests/fuzzing/fuzz_pkcs15_reader.c","function":"fuzz_get_chunk","line":57,"var":"c_size","code":"c_size = *((uint16_t *) data->Data);","note":"Each chunk length is derived from the attacker stream, controlling how much data is exposed to the parser and card emulation."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src/tests/fuzzing/fuzz_pkcs15_reader.c","function":"fuzz_reader_connect","line":99,"var":"reader->atr.value","code":"memcpy(reader->atr.value, chunk, chunk_size);","note":"The attacker-controlled chunk becomes the card ATR, influencing card identification and downstream PKCS#15 parsing."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src/tests/fuzzing/fuzz_pkcs15_reader.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":208,"var":"card","code":"sc_connect_card(reader, &card);","note":"The fake reader is connected, causing the attacker-controlled ATR/chunks to drive card initialization."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/tests/fuzzing/fuzz_pkcs15_reader.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":209,"var":"p15card","code":"sc_pkcs15_bind(card, NULL, &p15card);","note":"PKCS#15 binding parses the attacker-influenced card state and builds a PKCS#15 object list."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src/libopensc/pkcs15-sec.c","function":"format_senv","line":189,"var":"prkey->native","code":"if (!prkey->native) LOG_TEST_RET(ctx, SC_ERROR_NOT_SUPPORTED, \"This key is not native, cannot operate with it\");","note":"The vulnerable path is reached only for native private/secret keys, so the object metadata steers execution into the crypto helpers."},
  {"step":8,"file":"src/libopensc/pkcs15-sec.c","function":"use_key","line":154,"var":"r","code":"r = card_command(p15card->card, in, inlen, out, outlen);","note":"The actual cryptographic card command consumes attacker-controlled input and output buffers."},
  {"step":9,"file":"src/libopensc/card-tcos.c","function":"tcos_construct_fci","line":129,"var":"out/p","code":"/* FIXME: possible buffer overflow */","note":"The suspected memory-safety sink is the FCI construction path, where file metadata can overrun the fixed output buffer."}
]
p.write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, indent=2))
print('updated')
PY
bash ./submit.sh /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/opensc/src/tests/fuzzing/fuzz_pkcs15_reader.c /workspace/candidate_trace.json
